title: feat: unify registry and community fallback routing
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Routes registry and community fallbacks through one depth-one executor for text and the existing image/video path.
- Adds an ordered registry `fallbacks` declaration field without declaring any pairs yet.
- Keeps caller pricing anchored to the requested model while provider cost and served-model telemetry follow the model that ran.
- Trusts registry-owned declarations without price, visibility, availability, dimension, or compatibility guards.
- Keeps community-authored active-state, ownership/privacy, modality, and price rules; a developer’s public model may target their own private model.

Audio, embeddings, realtime, and 3D are isolated in stacked draft #12990.

Validation: pinned Biome 2.3.10, Gen and Enter typechecks, full core Gen suite 802/802, focused Enter boundary tests 13/13, and green GitHub lint/CodeQL. Staging forced-failure smoke passed for registry text and image fallbacks; the clean bundle was restored afterward.

gist.headline: Fallbacks share one trail
gist.blurb: The hive’s backup routes now follow one well-marked path instead of wandering through separate tunnels. Text joins the established image and video fallback flow, while the receipt still names the model you asked for.
gist.summary: Unified registry and community fallback routing behind a depth-one executor for text plus the existing image/video path, with ordered registry fallback declarations and telemetry recording the model that actually served the request.
gist.impact: When a requested model needs a fallback, callers keep requested-model pricing while provider-cost accounting and served-model telemetry accurately reflect the model that ran.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy garden crossroads where several model-path signposts converge into one clearly marked fallback trail. Polli, wearing a tiny trail-guide hat, points toward the shared path while a retro CRT robot records the requested model on one clipboard and the actually served model on another; small code-plants and registry scrolls show that the routing is organized without losing provenance.
